note: Rewritten from the new-species description in Emerson 1960 (American Museum Novitates No. 1988); the original is in English. Only the soldier is described; the alate and the worker are not described. The measurements are taken from table 10 of that work: the values of the holotype column and of some paratype columns were truncated or displaced by OCR (the holotype values for head length to the tip of the frontal projection, head thickness, median length of the postmentum, and length of the left mandible from the tooth to the tip), so only the figures that can be read reliably are given, without guessing. From line 88 the source pack passes to the next species, Furculitermes parviceps, whose description is not used.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: The soldier's median part of the labrum is longer and the lateral lobes are wide with strongly curved outer margins, a combination unique among the known species of the genus. Compared with F. longilabius, the postmentum of this species is slightly raised in the middle in lateral view (evenly convex, without a swelling, in the latter), and the median notch of the anterior pronotal margin is deeper.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head slightly narrowed forwards. Upper margin of the head slightly convex in lateral view. Frontal projection rather wide in dorsal view (1.04 mm). Postmentum slightly raised in the middle in lateral view. Antennae 15-segmented. Median part of the labrum longer, the lateral lobes wide with strongly curved outer margins. Mandibles slightly elbowed, the middle section rather straight. Median notch of the anterior pronotal margin deeper. Measurements (mm; holotype, paratype range in parentheses): head length with mandibles 3.68 (3.59); head length to the mandibular base 1.91 (1.74—1.88); head length to the tip of the frontal projection 1.65—1.79 (paratypes); head width 1.60 (1.53—1.72); head thickness including the postmentum 1.26; median length of the postmentum 0.85; maximum width of the postmentum 0.45 (0.43—0.46); minimum width of the postmentum 0.30; median length of the labrum 0.32 (0.27—0.32); length of the lateral lobe of the labrum from the base 1.04 (0.93—1.03); length of the left mandible 2.06 (1.97—2.12); length of the left mandible from the tooth to the tip 1.12—1.28 (paratypes); pronotum length 0.37 (0.37—0.41), width 0.83 (0.80—0.88); hind tibia length 1.18 (1.12—1.21).
